prompt: Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with shoulder injury after a low-speed head-on collision. The patient had 15 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1481; do not mention it.)
text:
The patient presented following a low-speed head-on motor vehicle collision with complaints of right shoulder pain, restricted range of motion, and intermittent numbness radiating into the right upper arm. Initial examination revealed tenderness over the anterior glenohumeral joint, decreased active abduction and external rotation, and mild weakness on resisted supraspinatus testing. Imaging showed no acute fracture or dislocation, and the working diagnosis was a right rotator cuff strain with associated capsular irritation.

Over the course of 15 visits, treatment consisted of a structured physical therapy program including manual therapy, progressive range-of-motion exercises, scapular stabilization, and graded strengthening. Modalities such as ultrasound and cryotherapy were used for symptom control during the early phase. Home exercise instruction was provided and reinforced at each visit.

By the final visit, the patient demonstrated substantial improvement in range of motion, strength returned to near-normal grades, and pain was reported at a low intermittent level with activity. Residual mild stiffness with overhead reaching persists. Continued home exercise and activity modification were recommended, with follow-up as needed for any recurrence of symptoms.
